# starcreates

> starcreates is a Roblox game development and publishing company co-founded by Theo Evans and Elliot Askew. The two founded the company together as a team and lead it as joint CEOs in an equal partnership. starcreates develops and operates its own Roblox experiences, including Build or Die and +1 ASMR Keyboard Destruction, and partners with, invests in and acquires Roblox games from other developers.

## Key facts

- Name: starcreates (also written "star creates")
- Website: https://starcreates.org
- Industry: Roblox game development, publishing, investment and acquisitions
- Co-founders and joint CEOs: Theo Evans and Elliot Askew (equal partners)
- Over 2 million play sessions across all starcreates games
- More than 342,000 players and around 24,500 monthly active users
- Contact: hello@starcreates.org
- X / Twitter: https://x.com/starcreates_dev
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/starcreates/

## Leadership

starcreates has two CEOs. Theo Evans and Elliot Askew co-founded the company together as a team; both are co-founders and both hold the title Co-Founder & CEO. Neither reports to the other. Theo leads development, game systems and acquisitions. Elliot leads growth, community and content.

### Theo Evans – Co-Founder & CEO

- Handles: @infirmn (Roblox), also known as "inf"
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/theo-at-starcreates/
- Roblox game developer and software engineer with 7+ years of development experience
- Has contributed to Roblox games that have collectively surpassed 4 billion play sessions
- Ranked in the top 1,000 Roblox developers on the platform for two years in a row
- Invited to the Roblox Developers Conference (RDC) 2025 and 2026
- Has worked with names including Team17

Theo's bio, in Theo's own words (from LinkedIn):

> I'm a Roblox Game Developer, Software Engineer, and Founder & CEO of starcreates.
>
> With over 7 years of development experience, I specialise in building large-scale Roblox experiences, developing complex game systems, and turning ideas into successful products. My role at starcreates is managing, acquiring and developing highly engaging and creative experiences on the platform.
>
> Across my work, I've contributed to games that have collectively surpassed 4 billion play sessions on the Roblox platform. Following that success, I have been invited to many events, including the Roblox Developers Conference (RDC) 2025 and 2026. I have been in the top 1,000 Roblox developers on the platform for two years in a row.
>
> I'm passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with Roblox Studio, building innovative experiences, and growing starcreates into something bigger.
>
> Always open to connecting with developers, studios, and industry professionals.

### Elliot Askew – Co-Founder & CEO

- Handles: @ESGaminggg, also known as "esyt"
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/elliot-askew/
- Leads the growth of starcreates, manages development across all projects and builds the community
- Turns early prototypes into high-quality, long-lasting titles
- Content creator and video editor whose YouTube channels have tens of thousands of subscribers, with videos regularly reaching 50,000+ views and millions of total views across social media

## Games

- Build or Die: 2M+ visits, 25,900+ favourites, 84,300+ likes, peak of 724 concurrent players
- [+1 ASMR Keyboard Destruction](https://www.roblox.com/games/87361386694346): 59,800+ visits, 2,300+ favourites, peak of 378 concurrent players
- A new, larger project is in development
